description.narrative: The project is implemented in Palestine. The main outcome areas it contributes to are promoting peace and dialogue mitigating armed conflict and social tensions. The rights holders and targeted actors are local civil society organisations, such as CBOs, local authorities and local public committees but also relevant national authorities that have a stake in conflict solution. Through building a database for conflict analysis, training actors (such as CBOs) to deal with conflict using evidence based methods and inclusive methods, and involving stakeholders in dialogue meetings, workshops and other fora, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Ta awon for Conflict Resolution and the Palme Center.Ta awon is an organisation working to raise awareness and lead intervention in civic engagement and participation in conflict resolution and transformation, peacebuilding and good governance. They have strong connections to local CBOs, authorities and communities, assisting them in solving conflicts and improving governance for the sake of especially marginalised groups like youth and women.Other Donors to the OrganisationIn addition to the Palme center, Ta awon have a short term grant from GIZ. There are possibilities for coordination but this is not necessarily a priority.Project ObjectiveTa awon wants to contribute to institutionalizing sustainable conflict transformation and promote peacebuilding, through establishing and institutionalising a system to analyse and address conflict in various fields of society and to increase the capacity of CBOs to resolve conflict in an inclusive manner.Actor groupsDecision-makers: governor office, including tribal reform units, water authority, ministry of interior, ministry of religious affairs and others. Local authorities.Actors working in cooperation: unions, social movements, political parties and the private sector as well as CBOs.Rights holders: Youth and women, workers, and others that are parts to local conflicts of various kinds.
